thread:
Cincinnati has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than any other big Ohio university. Ohio State is 15 behind.

Every Ohio university with 10,000+ students:

1. Cincinnati: 101
2. Ohio State: 86
3. Cleveland State: 71
4. Ohio University: 63
5. Case Western: 60
6. Bowling Green: 47
7. Dayton: 46
8. Youngstown State: 42
9. Akron: 30
10. Toledo: 13
10. Miami (Ohio): 13
12. Kent State: 5

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/campus/oh

How to tell good pizza before you order:

Look at the edge of the crust. Dark, uneven blisters mean a very hot oven. An even, pale crust usually means a conveyor oven.

Three more signs:

- Dough fermented for days, not made that morning
- Three toppings, not nine (too many make it soggy)
- Sauce that tastes like tomato, not sugar

Lift a slice. If it leaves a pool of grease, the cheese is cheap.

More on pizza styles and what to order: https://www.savorscout.net/food/pizza
